title: Great job!
body: Beautiful UX, great integration into shortcuts and data sources, awesome widget.
author: Ofir Pearl

title: Missing essentials
body:
Overall it’s good but it’s missing essential functionality.

What if I want to set a habit of exercising 4 times per week, 20 min per day?

When setting weekly habits you can’t know which days in the week you completed them nor how many minutes per day… disappointing 

When setting daily habits you can’t set the amount per week, only choose specific days or interval… disappointing
author: NowMemory

title: Love it.
body: Subscription is a little pricey but definitely worth it. Could have some more features ideally but the beautiful UI makes up for it. Can’t see this app evolve and become even better.

title: Great and Simple to use
body: A no frills habits app, really recommend to use for everyday tracking.
